project.purpose: Durable semantic re-entry and collaboration persistence; remember claims without promoting them into foreign truth.

kernelLaws: Host owns Host-local identity/revision/persisted bytes, not foreign truth.
Discovery and attention are projections, never priority or execution admission.
Prefer external substrate owners; retain custom code only for irreducible continuity semantics.

retained.name: WorkRevisionLedger
retained.responsibility: Persist revisioned, durable semantic Work identity, state and snapshots independent of conversation history.
behavioralContract: Same request semantics admit idempotent Work creation; conflicting parallel initial snapshots reject; PostgreSQL transaction/lock semantics remain external
formalObligations: Linearizable create/ref identity under concurrent writes; installed PG currentness UNKNOWN
retained.evidenceStanding: SOURCE_BOUND_IMPLEMENTATION_AND_TESTS; installed/live/domain/Formal beyond named native tests UNKNOWN

retained.name: WorkSnapshotCAS
retained.responsibility: Qualify and durably commit one exact Work semantic continuation revision with optimistic compare-and-swap.
outputs: new Work revision or typed conflict
behavioralContract: Concurrent commits to same expected revision must not both succeed; response-loss replay does not fork work identity
formalObligations: CAS/concurrency/refinement to DB transaction; installed PG state UNKNOWN
retained.evidenceStanding: SOURCE_BOUND_IMPLEMENTATION_AND_TESTS; installed/live/domain/Formal beyond named native tests UNKNOWN

retained.name: WorkRelationAcyclicity
retained.responsibility: Represent cross-Work parent and dependency semantic edges while rejecting cyclic parenthood.
outputs: bounded Work DAG and relation readback
behavioralContract: Self and cross-request parent cycles fail closed; links are not scheduling or acceptance authority
formalObligations: Acyclicity under concurrent PG transactions; nonparent relation interpretation remains consumer-specific
retained.evidenceStanding: SOURCE_BOUND_IMPLEMENTATION_AND_TESTS; installed/live/domain/Formal beyond named native tests UNKNOWN

retained.name: SpaceParticipation
retained.responsibility: Keep conversation Space scope, subjects and actor participation independent of Work assignment.
behavioralContract: Space is not nested under one Work; participation does not authorize Runtime effects or imply ownership
formalObligations: Scope membership semantics and concurrency/currentness; authorization is separate
retained.evidenceStanding: SOURCE_BOUND_IMPLEMENTATION_AND_TESTS; installed/live/domain/Formal beyond named native tests UNKNOWN

retained.name: TopicMessageJournal
retained.responsibility: Persist structured messages with exact Space, Topic, actor and relation identity.
outputs: durable MessageRef and ordered Topic message sequence
behavioralContract: Reply and mention are typed relations, not untyped chat role; source refs are not domain truth
formalObligations: Ordered persistence, exact readback and no forged consumer claim
retained.evidenceStanding: SOURCE_BOUND_IMPLEMENTATION_AND_TESTS; installed/live/domain/Formal beyond named native tests UNKNOWN

retained.name: TopicResumeCursor
retained.responsibility: Resume an exact Topic message stream using its per-topic cursor, independently of the global Attention change clock.
outputs: bounded message replay page and readback cursor
behavioralContract: Topic cursor must not be substituted with the global Attention change-sequence cursor
formalObligations: Cursor monotonicity, exact no-skip semantics under concurrent message append
retained.evidenceStanding: SOURCE_BOUND_IMPLEMENTATION_AND_TESTS; installed/live/domain/Formal beyond named native tests UNKNOWN

retained.name: AttentionChangeProjection
retained.responsibility: Project relevant Social Work change sequences into actor-scoped discover/re-entry navigation.
outputs: bounded relevant change page and cursor
behavioralContract: Global cursor is not Topic cursor; attention is not ranking, priority or scheduling authority
formalObligations: No missed relevant changes under bounded concurrent commits; installed cursor/replay UNKNOWN
retained.evidenceStanding: SOURCE_BOUND_IMPLEMENTATION_AND_TESTS; installed/live/domain/Formal beyond named native tests UNKNOWN

retained.name: WorkInventory
retained.responsibility: Provide bounded visible Work listing for navigation without interpreting semantic priority or acceptance.
behavioralContract: Listing is not discovery of objective value, task scheduling or consumer acceptance
acceptance: Public Host work.list MCP contract and Gateway forwarding exist at current SourceCut
formalObligations: Stable pagination and currentness of selected Work list under concurrent updates
retained.evidenceStanding: SOURCE_BOUND_IMPLEMENTATION_AND_TESTS; installed/live/domain/Formal beyond named native tests UNKNOWN

retained.name: MessageSearchPostgreSQL
retained.responsibility: Apply PostgreSQL-backed bounded Message search without creating a second Host search index.
behavioralContract: PostgreSQL owns indexing and FTS; Host supplies scope/identity but not independent search storage
acceptance: Public Host message.search MCP contract and Gateway forwarding exist at current SourceCut
formalObligations: Search scope containment and source-to-installed PG index correctness UNKNOWN
retained.evidenceStanding: SOURCE_BOUND_IMPLEMENTATION_AND_TESTS; installed/live/domain/Formal beyond named native tests UNKNOWN

retained.name: MutationReplayContract
retained.responsibility: Preserve exact idempotent mutation identity and replay under response loss across Work and social API effects.
inputs: caller mutation identity and canonical payload
outputs: same committed result or typed conflict
behavioralContract: Concurrent/replayed identical semantic requests do not duplicate external effect; divergent requests cannot alias
formalObligations: Semantic idempotency and recovery across DB failover remain separately proven
retained.evidenceStanding: SOURCE_BOUND_IMPLEMENTATION_AND_TESTS; installed/live/domain/Formal beyond named native tests UNKNOWN
